Bachelorette Party

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Keep the group together from the first pickup through dinner, pool plans, and Old Town. Choose a party-style cabin, add the stops that matter, and set one clear return plan before the night begins.

Prices start at $145 an hour for the Executive Black Sprinter, which seats 14, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $580 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

Frequently asked questions

Can we decorate the Sprinter?

Add decoration requests to the trip details. The team will review them against the selected vehicle, and the written confirmation will identify what is approved and any surface restrictions.

Can we bring our own alcohol?

Alcohol may be permitted for passengers 21+ only when lawful, approved for the selected vehicle, and stated in the written booking terms.

What's the best night for bachelorettes in Scottsdale?

Choose the date around the venues and reservations the group wants. Hours, admission policies, demand, traffic, and curb access vary by date, so confirm each venue directly before submitting the route.
